findings.title: Date window filters first_redemption_date instead of partner join date
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — the MV (V28) groups by first_redemption_date and has no partner join/created_at column; filtering on first_redemption_date is the only correct option for this MV. Contract description text saying 'join date' is imprecise copy from an earlier tier-based design.
findings.recommendation: No code change needed. Update the contract description text to say 'first redemption date' instead of 'join date' in a follow-up story.

findings.title: Zero-redemption regions silently omitted despite promised sampleCount=0 rows
findings.tierReason: severity=medium → advisory (not blocking regardless of alreadyHandled). Genuine design gap: MV uses INNER JOIN to first_rr so regions with no completed redemptions produce no MV rows; the CASE WHEN SUM(sample_count)=0 is unreachable from live MV data. However, fixing requires a Flyway migration and new region-dimension table which is out of scope for US-03.
findings.recommendation: Raise a follow-up story to either (a) add region-dimension table and left-join in the query, or (b) document in the spec that 'sampleCount=0 rows' only appear when a region exists in the MV but all daily cohorts have been aggregated to zero (effectively never from current MV design).
